communications.subject: Charge inquiry - TXN-980145359
communications.body:
Hi,

I noticed a charge of $24000 on my statement from Enterprise Solutions. I would like to understand this charge and request a resolution.

Regards,
Eleanor Vance

communications.subject: RE: Charge inquiry - TXN-980145359
communications.body: The merchant, Enterprise Solutions, stated they only see one transaction on their system and could not resolve the duplicate charge. They advised the cardholder to contact their issuing bank.
